A change to zdr-posture-matrix.json rows must update every file that includes it (grep the include) and their row-count constants. slices.title: Role table and the verevon-role resolver
slices.summary: Adds a defaulted roles table (title, follow_ups, verification_judge, research_plan; 1-4 candidates each) to RoutingPolicy JSON and a verevon-role resolver in inference-core that requires a purpose and applies the D7 filters, with PUT validation returning 400 invalid_role_table. Proto: RouteNote.role=5, role_source=6 and InferRequest.role_fallback_model=23 (round A moved it from 22). Gateway title/follow-ups/judge/research-plan send verevon-role behind MODEL_GATEWAY_ROLE_ROUTING (default off, byte-identical when off); roll out inference-core first. No migration, session-core stores opaque JSON. Needs a role_routing bool sibling on /v1/models for S5.

decisions_defaults.D6: Role table lives inside the platform RoutingPolicy singleton (scope inference:policy:admin); per-org tables stay W4 (F-t3-065).
decisions_defaults.D7: Ordered candidates, first that passes filters (catalogue, entitlement, ZDR/privacy/residency floors, no-reasoning for small-budget purposes); else the turn's own model; else cheap_fallback / aux_model(). A side task never fails a turn.

slices.title: Citation chips bind by server number
slices.summary: ChatCitationEvent, Citation and normalizeCitation carry the server-assigned `number`, and [n] markers resolve with citations.find(c => c.number === n), falling back to array position only when no citation in the turn has a number. Adds the citation-number test (gap case, unread rows, mixed KB+web, fallback) and a citation golden payload row. No proto, no migration, no flag.
